models.notes: Announced 9 Sep 2024, released 20 Sep 2024. Non-ANC model with a USB-C case and H2 chip. Battery conflict: iFixit/Apple give 5 h buds / 30 h total; one Indian news summary also mentioned 24 h with the case, so 30 h (max claim) is used. wirelessCharging=false because iFixit lists wireless charging only on the ANC model. Status: superseded by AirPods 5 (Sep 2026) and reportedly on Apple's discontinuation list, but discontinuation was not confirmed in the captured sources.

Announced 9 Sep 2024, released 20 Sep 2024. Adds ANC, a wireless-charging case and a case speaker over the base AirPods 4. ANC-on 4 h comes from Apple's AirPods 5 comparison quoted by 91mobiles. The 4.3 g weight and IP54 come from the iFixit AirPods 4 device page, which covers both models. Status: superseded by AirPods 5 (Sep 2026) and reportedly on the discontinuation list, but not confirmed in the captured sources.

Announced 9 Sep 2026; sales from 18 Sep 2026 (US and India). Base model (no Wireless Charging Case, no stem volume control). ANC is standard on all AirPods 5, claimed to remove up to 50% more noise than AirPods 4 with ANC, with Adaptive Audio switching between ANC and Transparency. 5 h per charge with ANC (vs 4 h for AirPods 4 ANC). The captured sources gave no total-with-case or ANC-off figure for this base model (the 22 h figure belongs to the Wireless Charging Case model). IP57 per Apple specs; one Indian news source said IP54. The 4.3 g weight is Apple's 'each AirPod' figure on the AirPods 5 spec page. wirelessCharging=false because only the Rs 17,900/$149 variant adds a Wireless Charging Case.

Announced 9 Sep 2026; sales from 18 Sep 2026. Adds a Wireless Charging Case (USB-C, Apple Watch charger or Qi) and swipe-on-stem volume control. Battery: 5 h per charge with ANC, 22 h total with case with ANC (Apple specs); 5 min in the case gives about 1 h. No ANC-off figures were captured. ANC is claimed to be 50% better than AirPods 4 ANC (no dB figure). IP57 per Apple specs; one Indian news source said IP54.

USB-C MagSafe Charging Case refresh of AirPods Pro 2 (H2 chip; U1 chip in the case; the case has a speaker and lanyard loop). India launch price Rs 24,900. Battery: 6 h with ANC, 30 h with the case. The captured sources had no release month or US price, so both are left null. Superseded by AirPods Pro 3 (Sep 2025); current sale status not confirmed. wirelessCharging comes from the MagSafe case.

Announced 9 Sep 2025; India pre-orders same day, sales from 19 Sep 2025 at Rs 25,900. Apple India raised the price to Rs 27,900 after the AirPods 5 launch (Sep 2026), so mrpINR is the post-hike Apple India price, not the launch price. Battery: 8 h with ANC, 10 h in Transparency/hearing-aid mode, 6.5 h with heart-rate sensing. batteryTotalMax 24 h is Apple's figure with ANC on (MagSafe Charging Case); the captured sources gave no higher ANC-off total. wirelessCharging comes from Apple calling it a 'MagSafe Charging Case'.
